verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own agentic workflows act automatically on events: they escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review and auto-remediate level 1 alerts. Users can also configure the risk-score equation and screening/monitoring configurations, and the Starter-plan FAQ implies agent configurations can be customized on other plans. However, nothing documents a general user-authored rule engine (if event X then action Y), and the webhooks only notify external consumers rather than act as configurable triggers. missing for 10: documented user-defined event→action rule builder, explicit customizable trigger conditions and action types, transaction-monitoring rule authoring docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
